NOTE: sovereignty is disputed — Nepal claims the southern (Kalapani) side under the 1816 Treaty of Sugauli; the pass is currently administered by India. Listed per owner field-list (Darchula). No road access; routes here are honest straight-line estimates. Owner field-list addition 2026-09-21.

6774.name: Ainselukharka
6774.description: Ainselukharka (Ainselu Kharka) is a town and former VDC in Khotang District, eastern Nepal, now the centre of Ainselukharka Rural Municipality.

6775.name: Tinjure Danda
6775.description: Tinjure (Tinjure Danda) is a rhododendron-covered ridge on the Tinjure-Milke-Jaljale circuit across the Dhankuta-Terhathum borderlands, with viewpoints toward Kanchenjunga and Makalu.

6776.name: Chhintapu
6776.description: Chhintapu is a village in the Sandakpur hills of Ilam District, near the Sandakpur ridge trails.

6777.name: Balankha
6777.description: Balankha (Walangkha) is a village and former VDC in Bhojpur District, eastern Nepal, with a small bazaar serving surrounding hill villages.

6778.name: Rakha Dipsung
6778.description: Rakha Dipsung is a village and former VDC in Khotang District, eastern Nepal.

6779.name: Tilaurakot
6779.description: Tilaurakot is an archaeological site in Kapilvastu Municipality, widely identified as the ancient Shakya city of Kapilavastu where Gautama Buddha spent his first 29 years. A fortified citadel on the Banaganga river, UNESCO tentative list since 1996.

6780.name: Nigalihawa
6780.description: Nigalihawa (ancient Sobhavati) is a village in Kapilvastu District regarded in Theravada tradition as the birthplace of Konagamana Buddha. The Ashokan Nigali Sagar pillar stands here, 4.5 km northwest of Tilaurakot.

6781.name: Gotihawa
6781.description: Gotihawa (ancient Khemavati) is a village in Kapilvastu District regarded as the birthplace of Kakusandha Buddha. The base of an Ashokan pillar (protected monument NP-KP-04) was discovered here, 4 km southeast of Kapilvastu.

6782.name: Simraungadh
6782.description: Simraungadh is a municipality in Bara District on the Nepal-India border containing the ruins of the medieval Karnat capital Simraungadh, visited by pilgrims and historians since Dharmasvamin (1236). 28 km east of Birgunj.

6783.name: Amlekhganj
6783.description: Amlekhganj is a town in Bara District, historically the terminus of the Nepal Government Railway from Raxaul (India). The Churiya Mai Temple sits nearby on the Hetauda-Birgunj highway.

6784.name: Kankalini Temple
6784.description: Kankalini Temple is a Hindu Shakti Peetha in Bhardaha, Saptari, 19 km east of Rajbiraj near the Indian border at Birpur, on the Mahendra Highway. A major Dashain pilgrimage site for Nepali and Indian devotees.

6785.name: Panchakot
6785.description: Panchakot is a hilltop viewpoint area near Baglung bazaar, known for sunrise views over the town and the Kali Gandaki valley.

6786.name: Barahathwa
6786.description: Barahathwa is a town and municipality centre in Sarlahi District on the East-West Highway corridor, a local market hub for surrounding farming villages.

6787.name: Hariwan
6787.description: Hariwan (Harion) is a town and municipality in Sarlahi District spanning the Chure range, Bhabar and Outer Terai, with its administration centre at Harion Bazar.

6788.name: Ishwarpur
6788.description: Ishwarpur (Ishworpur) is a municipality in Sarlahi District formed in 2014 from the Bela, Bhaktipur, Gaurishankar and Ishwarpur VDCs.

6789.name: Golbazar
6789.description: Golbazar is a municipality in Siraha District on the East-West Highway, a major Terai market town formed from nine former VDCs in 2017.

6790.name: Chhinnamasta
6790.description: Chhinnamasta is a village and rural municipality centre in Saptari District, 10 km south of Rajbiraj, named for the goddess Chhinnamasta worshipped across Nepal and northern India.

6791.name: Malarani
6791.description: Malarani is a rural municipality in Arghakhanchi District with its administrative centre at Khandaha, formed in 2017 from seven former VDCs.

6792.name: Matihani
6792.description: Matihani is a municipality in Mahottari District near the Indo-Nepal border, home to the Lakshminarayan Matha (one of Nepal's largest Lakshmi-Narayan temples) and a stop on the Mithila Madhya Parikrama.

6793.name: Dhorpatan Hunting Reserve
6793.description: Nepal's only hunting reserve with regulated sport hunting, spanning 1,325 km2 of the Dhaulagiri Himal across Baglung, Myagdi and Eastern Rukum (2,850-5,500 m). Alpine patan meadows, blue sheep habitat, Tibetan refugee settlement at the HQ valley.

6794.name: Sukhipur
6794.description: Sukhipur is a municipality in Siraha District formed in 2015 from seven VDCs, centred on Sukhipur Bazaar with a border road link to Ladanya Bazar, Bihar.

6795.name: Kalyanpur
6795.description: Kalyanpur is a municipality in Siraha District in south-eastern Nepal's Terai.

6796.name: Rupani
6796.description: Rupani is a rural municipality in Saptari District named after Rupani Devi, known for the Shiva Sani Dham shrine in the northern Chure foothills and the Dinaram Bhadri Temple at Kataiya.

6797.name: Panchadewal Binayak
6797.description: Panchadewal Binayak is a municipality in Achham District formed in 2017 from eight former VDCs, with its administrative centre at Kuika.

6798.name: Ramaroshan Lakes
6798.description: The Ramaroshan lake cluster (Jhyalini lakes and patans) lies in Ramaroshan Rural Municipality, Achham — a highland wetland area of ponds and alpine meadows. Pin is the rural municipality centre; individual lakes are scattered across the RM.

6799.name: Budha Subba Temple
6799.description: Budha Subba Temple (Manghim) is a revered shrine in Bijayapur, Dharan-14, on the bank of the Seuti river, known for its tip-less bamboo grove and earthen mounds worshipped as Budha Subba. Historically linked to the Limbuwan kingdom's capital at Bijaypur.

6800.name: Pindeshwor Temple
6800.description: Pindeshwor Temple is a Shiva temple in Dharan, Sunsari, at the foot of Vijayapur Hill. Devotees carry holy water from the Koshi river barefoot every Monday of Shraavana; major gatherings on Balachaturdasi and Maha Shivaratri.

6801.name: Dantakali Temple
6801.description: Dantakali Temple is a pagoda-style Hindu temple in Bijayapur, Dharan, revered as the place where the sacred teeth (danta) of goddess Satidevi lie. Major festivals: Navaratri and Dashain.

6802.name: Barahachhetra
6802.description: Barahachhetra is one of Nepal's oldest Hindu and Kirat pilgrimage sites, at the confluence of the Koka and Koshi rivers, mentioned in the Brahma, Varaha and Skanda Puranas and the Mahabharata. Hosts a semi-Kumbha Mela every twelve years.

6803.name: Jaleshwar Mahadev Temple
6803.description: Jaleshwarnath Mahadev is a Shiva temple in Jaleshwar, the district headquarters of Mahottari, near the Indian border at Bhitthamore. The town is named after the temple; huge gatherings during Shravan.

6804.name: Sitganga
6804.description: Sitganga is a municipality in Arghakhanchi District formed in 2017 from seven former VDCs, with its administrative centre at Thada.

6933.name: Makalu
6933.description: Fifth highest peak (8,485 m) with the classic pyramid shape. Located in Sankhuwasabha district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6933.short_description: Fifth highest peak (8,485 m) with the classic pyramid shape.

6934.name: Cho Oyu
6934.description: Sixth highest peak (8,188 m) on Tibet border. Located in Solukhumbu district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6934.short_description: Sixth highest peak (8,188 m) on Tibet border.

6935.name: Machhapuchhare Model View Point
6935.description: Classic viewpoint overlooking Machhapuchhre and the Annapurnas. Located in Kaski district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6935.short_description: Classic viewpoint overlooking Machhapuchhre and the Annapurnas.

6936.name: Mardi Himal
6936.description: Popular short trek to a 5,587 m ridge with breathtaking Fishtail views. Located in Kaski district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6936.short_description: Popular short trek to a 5,587 m ridge with breathtaking Fishtail views.

6937.name: Indra Sarovar
6937.description: Largest man-made reservoir in Nepal, popular for boating. Located in Makwanpur district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6937.short_description: Largest man-made reservoir in Nepal, popular for boating.

6938.name: Shree Antu
6938.description: Famous for sunrise over Kanchenjunga and emerald tea gardens. Located in Ilam district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6938.short_description: Famous for sunrise over Kanchenjunga and emerald tea gardens.

6939.name: Kakani
6939.description: 2,030 m hill station on the north-west rim of Kathmandu Valley; trout farms and views. Located in Nuwakot district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6939.short_description: 2,030 m hill station on the north-west rim of Kathmandu Valley; trout farms and views.

6940.name: Tansen (Palpa)
6940.description: Historic Newari hill town with traditional architecture and Shreenagar hill views. Located in Palpa district, Lumbini province, Nepal.
6940.short_description: Historic Newari hill town with traditional architecture and Shreenagar hill views.

6941.name: Nuwakot Durbar
6941.description: Seven-storied hilltop palace; Prithvi Narayan Shah's base for conquering Kathmandu. Located in Nuwakot district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6941.short_description: Seven-storied hilltop palace; Prithvi Narayan Shah's base for conquering Kathmandu.

6942.name: Jalbire Jharana (Chitwan)
6942.description: 100 m natural waterfall and swimming pools on the way to Langtang. Located in Chitwan district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6942.short_description: 100 m natural waterfall and swimming pools on the way to Langtang.

6943.name: World Peace Pagoda (Pokhara)
6943.description: White Buddhist stupa on a hilltop south of Phewa Lake, panoramic Annapurna views. Located in Kaski district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6943.short_description: White Buddhist stupa on a hilltop south of Phewa Lake, panoramic Annapurna views.

6944.name: Rara National Park
6944.description: Smallest national park surrounding pristine Rara Lake at 2,990 m. Located in Mugu district, Karnali province, Nepal.
6944.short_description: Smallest national park surrounding pristine Rara Lake at 2,990 m.

6945.name: Annapurna Conservation Area
6945.description: Largest protected area in Nepal (7,629 km²); Annapurna Circuit, snow leopard, diverse bio-zones. Located in Manang district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6945.short_description: Largest protected area in Nepal (7,629 km²); Annapurna Circuit, snow leopard, diverse bio-zones.

6946.name: Tatopani Hot Spring
6946.description: Natural hot springs on the Annapurna Circuit/Base Camp trek; relaxing mineral pools. Located in Myagdi district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6946.short_description: Natural hot springs on the Annapurna Circuit/Base Camp trek; relaxing mineral pools.

6947.name: Jomsom (Kagbeni)
6947.description: Windy arid trans-Himalayan town; gateway to Upper Mustang, apple orchards, Muktinath. Located in Mustang district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6947.short_description: Windy arid trans-Himalayan town; gateway to Upper Mustang, apple orchards, Muktinath.

6948.name: Marpha
6948.description: Whitewashed stone village famous for apple brandy, orchards, and Thakali cuisine. Located in Mustang district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6948.short_description: Whitewashed stone village famous for apple brandy, orchards, and Thakali cuisine.

6949.name: Kirtipur
6949.description: Historic hilltop Newar town south-west of Kathmandu; Bagh Bhairab, Uma Maheshwar, Chilancho Stupa. Located in Kathmandu district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6949.short_description: Historic hilltop Newar town south-west of Kathmandu; Bagh Bhairab, Uma Maheshwar, Chilancho Stupa.

6950.name: Lukla Airport (Tenzing-Hillary)
6950.description: Starting point for Everest treks; one of the world's most dramatic airports. Located in Solukhumbu district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6950.short_description: Starting point for Everest treks; one of the world's most dramatic airports.

6951.name: Ilam Tea Gardens
6951.description: Rolling green tea estates in far-eastern Nepal; Kanyam, Shree Antu viewpoints. Located in Ilam district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6951.short_description: Rolling green tea estates in far-eastern Nepal; Kanyam, Shree Antu viewpoints.

6952.name: Kanyam
6952.description: "Queen of Ilam" -- most visited tea garden with horse rides, picnic spots, Kanchenjunga views. Located in Ilam district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6952.short_description: "Queen of Ilam" -- most visited tea garden with horse rides, picnic spots, Kanchenjunga views.

6953.name: Dolpo (Shey Gompa)
6953.description: Crystal Mountain and 11th-century Shey Gompa in Upper Dolpo; Tibetan Buddhist pilgrimage. Located in Dolpa district, Karnali province, Nepal.
6953.short_description: Crystal Mountain and 11th-century Shey Gompa in Upper Dolpo; Tibetan Buddhist pilgrimage.

6954.name: Kodari (Zhangmu) Border
6954.description: Historic Nepal-China border crossing on the Arniko Highway; Tibet border views. Located in Sindhupalchok district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6954.short_description: Historic Nepal-China border crossing on the Arniko Highway; Tibet border views.

6955.name: Hiunchuli
6955.description: 6,441m peak guarding Annapurna Sanctuary. Located in Kaski district, Gandaki province, Nepal.

6956.name: Ama Dablam
6956.description: 6,812m iconic peak known as the Matterhorn of Nepal. Located in Solukhumbu district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6956.short_description: 6,812m iconic peak known as the Matterhorn of Nepal.

6957.name: Bungamati
6957.description: Medieval Newar village, home of Rato Machhindranath. Located in Lalitpur district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6957.short_description: Medieval Newar village, home of Rato Machhindranath.

6958.name: Golden Gate (Bhaktapur)
6958.description: Repousse gilt copper gate to 55-Window Palace. Located in Bhaktapur district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6958.short_description: Repousse gilt copper gate to 55-Window Palace.

6959.name: Sindhuli Gadhi
6959.description: Historic Gorkha victory fort over British forces. Located in Sindhuli district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6959.short_description: Historic Gorkha victory fort over British forces.

6960.name: Daman
6960.description: Mountain viewpoint claiming broadest Himalayan panorama. Located in Makwanpur district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6960.short_description: Mountain viewpoint claiming broadest Himalayan panorama.

6961.name: Koshi Tappu Wildlife Reserve
6961.description: Ramsar wetland; wild water buffalo, 500+ bird species. Located in Sunsari district, Koshi province, Nepal.
6961.short_description: Ramsar wetland; wild water buffalo, 500+ bird species.

6962.name: Siddha Cave (Siddha Gufa)
6962.description: Largest cave in Nepal (437m deep). Located in Tanahun district, Gandaki province, Nepal.

6963.name: Ghalegaun
6963.description: Model Gurung hill village at 2,100m; homestays. Located in Lamjung district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6963.short_description: Model Gurung hill village at 2,100m; homestays.

6964.name: Sirubari
6964.description: First model homestay village in Nepal; Gurung culture. Located in Syangja district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6964.short_description: First model homestay village in Nepal; Gurung culture.

6965.name: Lho
6965.description: Tibetan-Buddhist village on the Manaslu Circuit. Located in Gorkha district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6965.short_description: Tibetan-Buddhist village on the Manaslu Circuit.

6966.name: Dhampus
6966.description: Gurung village near Sarangkot; Australian Camp trek. Located in Kaski district, Gandaki province, Nepal.
6966.short_description: Gurung village near Sarangkot; Australian Camp trek.

6967.name: Thini (Jharkot)
6967.description: Ancient fort village above Jomsom. Located in Mustang district, Gandaki province, Nepal.

6968.name: Balthali
6968.description: Newar, Tamang, Magar village near Panauti; homestays. Located in Kavrepalanchok district, Bagmati province, Nepal.
6968.short_description: Newar, Tamang, Magar village near Panauti; homestays.

8720.name: Kupinde Daha Lake
8720.description: Kupinde Daha is a pristine high-altitude lake in Salyan District, Karnali Province. The lake changes color according to season and is surrounded by lush green hills, pine trees, and the revered Barah Temple. It is a peaceful destination for boating, nature photography, and cultural pilgrimages.
8720.short_description: Scenic mountain lake in Salyan surrounded by dense pine forests and sacred Barah shrine.

8721.name: Chhatreshwari Shakti Peeth
8721.description: Chhatreshwari Temple is a major Hindu pilgrimage site in Salyan. According to sacred scriptures, this is where Goddess Sati spine fell. Uniquely, animal sacrifices are strictly prohibited at this temple, and devotees offer flowers, belpatra, and sacred milk.
8721.short_description: Sacred Shakti Peeth temple on a hill ridge in Salyan venerated across Karnali.

8722.name: Sharada River & Luham Valley
8722.description: Luham Valley lies along the banks of the clear Sharada River in Salyan. Famous for its terraced organic ginger farms, citrus orchards, and mountain honey production, it offers scenic riverside walks and authentic rural village hospitality.
8722.short_description: Fertile agricultural valley along Sharada River famous for organic ginger and mountain honey.

8723.name: Ramgram Sacred Relic Stupa
8723.description: Ramgram Stupa is a ancient brick stupa located in Parasi (Nawalparasi West). It is the only stupa containing unopened original corporeal relics (Dhatu) of Lord Buddha, protected historically by a king cobra (Naga) and wild elephants under a grand Banyan tree.
8723.short_description: UNESCO tentative list site containing the only untouched corporal relics of Lord Buddha.

8724.name: Triveni Dham Confluence
8724.description: Triveni Dham is a sacred river confluence in Parasi at the junction of three rivers. It is surrounded by historic temples, Valmiki Ashram from Ramayana epic, and hosting the grand Maghe Sankranti Mela festival every winter.
8724.short_description: Holy confluence of Narayani, Sona, and Tamasa rivers near Valmiki Ashram.

8725.name: Jaleshwarnath Mahadev Temple
8725.description: Jaleshwarnath Temple in Jaleshwar, Mahottari, is a revered pilgrimage site where the main Shiva Lingam resides in an underground cave continuously submerged under natural spring water. Devotees visit during Shivaratri and Shrawan month to perform holy Jalabhishek.
8725.short_description: Historic submerged Shiva lingam temple immersed in natural underground spring water.

8726.name: Mithila Cultural Heritage Hub
8726.description: Located in Mahottari District, Pipara Mithila Cultural Center celebrates centuries of Maithili folk art, wall paintings, clay pottery, and traditional music. Visitors can observe local women artists hand-painting Mithila artwork on natural handmade paper.
8726.short_description: Artisan center for traditional Mithila folk painting, terracotta pottery, and Maithili crafts.

8727.name: Gorakhnath Temple & Jaljala Ridge
8727.description: Jaljala in Rolpa is a breathtaking alpine wetland plateau at 3,100m elevation. It features the sacred Gorakhnath Temple, rhododendron forests, and unobstructed views of Mt. Dhaulagiri, Mt. Kanjirowa, and Mt. Sisne.
8727.short_description: High alpine grassland plateau at 3,100m offering sweeping vistas of Dhaulagiri and Sisne peaks.

8728.name: Guerilla Trek Heritage Trail
8728.description: The Guerilla Trek passes through Thawang and the scenic heartland of Rolpa. It offers a unique cultural trek through remote Kham Magar indigenous villages, traditional slate-roofed houses, organic terraced farming, and wilderness river canyons.
8728.short_description: Historic trekking route through authentic Magar ethnic villages and pine forest gorges.

8729.name: Syarpu Lake & Resort
8729.description: Syarpu Lake (Syarpu Taal) is a freshwater lake located in Rukum West, Karnali Province. Spanning over 2.6 sq km, the lake is ideal for boating, fish tasting, and village homestays amidst terraced hills.
8729.short_description: Pristine mountain lake in Rukum West surrounded by terraced hills and local homestays.

8730.name: Sisne Himal Viewpoint
8730.description: Musikot viewpoint in Rukum West provides a dramatic vantage point facing Mt. Sisne (5,849m), the iconic virgin horn peak of Karnali. The area features pine forests, historic hill forts, and panoramic mountain sunrises.
8730.short_description: Majestic viewpoint facing the sacred unclimbed pyramid peak of Mt. Sisne (5,849m).

8731.name: Dhanushadham Sacred Forest
8731.description: Dhanushadham is a historic pilgrimage forest 18 km from Janakpur. According to Ramayana, a piece of Shiva bow fell here when Lord Ram broke it during Sita Swayamvar. The site features a petrified bow fossil shrine surrounded by a protected forest sanctuary.
8731.short_description: Mythological forest site where Shiva divine bow fell during Sita Swayamvar in Ramayana.

8732.name: Badimalika Sacred Meadows
8732.description: Badimalika in Bajura is one of Sudurpashchim most sacred mountain shrines, located atop rolling alpine meadows at 4,200m elevation. Devotees undertake a 3-day scenic trek through wildflower grasslands to worship Goddess Bhagwati during Janai Purnima.
8732.short_description: High alpine grassland shrine at 4,200m offering 360-degree Himalayan vistas.

8733.name: Salhesh Fulbari Miracle Garden
8733.description: Salhesh Fulbari in Siraha is a sacred historical garden associated with the ancient folk hero King Salhesh. Uniquely, rare Haram orchid flowers bloom on a specific tree in this garden only on Chaitra 31st (Nepali New Year Eve) and fade by the end of Baisakh 1st.
8733.short_description: Historical garden famous for the miracle blooming of orchids every Nepali New Year Eve.

8734.name: Halesi Mahadev Limestone Cave
8734.description: Halesi Mahadev Cave in Khotang is a natural limestone cave complex known as the Maratika Cave in Tibetan Buddhism and Pashupatinath of East Nepal. It is venerated as the place where Lord Shiva hid from demon Bhasmasur and Padmasambhava attained immortal life.
8734.short_description: Pashupatinath of East Nepal sacred natural cave venerated by Hindus, Buddhists, and Kirats.
